card.name: The verb look in looked/looking
card.fires_on: The word "looked" or "looking" (forms of look), usually right after "have", "I have", or "you're", before a particle such as up, for, at or to.

modes.label: Looked after have
modes.description: "looked" follows a form of have, as in searching or studying something.

modes.label: Looking for or at
modes.description: "looking" or "looked" is followed by for or at, in the sense of searching or examining.
